issues.description: Visibility mismatch for Lecture attributes: the template pre-declares lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents as public, while the problem statement UML (lines 63-68) and the reference solution implement these attributes as private and declare the additional attributes (numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) as private. This discrepancy can confuse students and let them bypass the intended exercise of implementing getters/setters and using encapsulation.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the pre-declared fields in the template to private to match the UML and solution (e.g. private String lectureName; private int numberOfInscribedStudents;). Also add the remaining attributes from the UML as private fields (numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) or keep TODOs that instruct students to add them. Keep the exercise focused on implementing the constructor, getters/setters and other methods that operate on private fields.
